content.short: Real WhiteDogs is a task-based social game on TON where users collect WTD tokens through daily activities.
content.description: Real WhiteDogs is a community-driven social game built on the TON blockchain, accessible as a Telegram Mini App. It encourages users to participate in a variety of daily activities, social tasks, and referral programs to collect WTD tokens. The project focuses on building a large and active community through straightforward and rewarding mechanics, preparing for a broader ecosystem launch. Real WhiteDogs is a prime example of the 'task-to-earn' trend on TON, providing a simple yet effective way for users to participate in and benefit from network growth.
content.meta: Complete tasks and earn with Real WhiteDogs on TON. Join the social rewards game on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
